name: An unjust death unavenged
description: Someone died wrongly and the world moved on: a maid drowned and called a suicide, a child exposed in the famine years, a farmhand killed in a quarrel and buried as an accident. The parish register says one thing and the dead say another. The restless dead, or a being bound to the place of death, will not be quiet until the truth is acknowledged, and the living who buried it have built their lives on its silence.

roleSlots.name: The one who caused the death
roleSlots.description: The person whose hand, neglect or cruelty brought the death; may be dead, respectable now, or genuinely remorseful.

roleSlots.name: The one who buried the truth
roleSlots.description: A relative, vicar, constable or district physician who wrote the convenient verdict, for kindness, for money or to protect a name.

roleSlots.name: The one who is haunted
roleSlots.description: The person the dead now torment, not always the guilty one; a new tenant, a grandchild, an unlucky lodger.

roleSlots.name: The one who still grieves
roleSlots.description: A mother, sweetheart or sibling who never believed the verdict and may be glad of the haunting.

roleSlots.name: The one who saw
roleSlots.description: Someone who saw what happened and has kept silent from fear, guilt or loyalty.

decoyIdeas: Grief-madness or hysteria in the haunted household, as the physician insists.
A living prankster or a vengeful relative staging the haunting to frighten an heir away.
The obvious suspect for the old death is a stranger or vagrant, while the truth lies inside the family.
